questionText.en: A traveller flies from Cape Town to a destination that is two hours ahead of South Africa. The flight leaves Cape Town at 08:00 and lasts 6 hours. At what local time will the traveller arrive? Show the two steps in your calculation.
questionText.af: ’n Reisiger vlieg van Kaapstad na ’n bestemming wat twee uur voor Suid-Afrika is. Die vlug vertrek om 08:00 uit Kaapstad en duur 6 uur. Hoe laat plaaslike tyd sal die reisiger aankom? Toon die twee stappe in jou berekening.
questionText.xh: Umhambi ubhabha esuka eKapa esiya kwindawo enexesha elingaphambili ngeeyure ezimbini kunoMzantsi Afrika. Inqwelomoya isuka eKapa ngo-08:00 kwaye ihamba iiyure ezi-6. Uza kufika nini ngexesha lendawo? Bonisa amanyathelo amabini ekubaleni kwakho.

scaffoldHint.en: First add the flight duration, then adjust for the destination time difference.
scaffoldHint.af: Tel eers die vlugduur by en pas dan vir die tydsverskil van die bestemming aan.
scaffoldHint.xh: Qala ngokudibanisa ixesha lenqwelomoya, emva koko ulungelelanise umahluko wexesha lendawo ekuyiwa kuyo.

memoText.en: 08:00 + 6 hours = 14:00 South African time. Destination is 2 hours ahead: 14:00 + 2 = 16:00 local time. (4)
memoText.af: 08:00 + 6 uur = 14:00 Suid-Afrikaanse tyd. Die bestemming is 2 uur voor: 14:00 + 2 = 16:00 plaaslike tyd. (4)
memoText.xh: 08:00 + iiyure ezi-6 = 14:00 ngexesha laseMzantsi Afrika. Indawo ekuyiwa kuyo iphambi ngeeyure ezi-2: 14:00 + 2 = 16:00 ngexesha lendawo. (4)

questionText.en: A group has one day in Cape Town and wants to visit three attractions efficiently. Give TWO factors a tour planner should consider when deciding the order of visits, and explain why each matters.
questionText.af: ’n Groep het een dag in Kaapstad en wil drie besienswaardighede doeltreffend besoek. Gee TWEE faktore wat ’n toerbeplanner moet oorweeg wanneer die volgorde van besoeke bepaal word, en verduidelik waarom elkeen belangrik is.
questionText.xh: Iqela linomhla omnye eKapa kwaye lifuna ukutyelela iindawo ezintathu ngendlela esebenzayo. Nika IMIBA EMIBINI ekufuneka umcwangcisi wohambo ayiqwalasele xa emisela ulandelelwano lotyelelo, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni nganye ibalulekile.

scaffoldHint.en: Think travel distance, opening times, booking times, traffic and how long visitors need at each site.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan reisafstand, openingstye, besprekingstye, verkeer en hoeveel tyd besoekers by elke plek benodig.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngomgama wohambo, amaxesha okuvula, amaxesha okubhukisha, izithuthi kunye nexesha elifunekayo kwindawo nganye.

memoText.en: Any two explained: distance/travel time; opening and closing times; fixed booking slots; expected traffic; time required at each attraction; accessibility or group needs. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Enige twee verduidelik: afstand/reistyd; openings- en sluitingstye; vasgestelde besprekingstye; verwagte verkeer; tyd benodig by elke besienswaardigheid; toeganklikheid of groepbehoeftes. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Naziphi na ezimbini ezichaziweyo: umgama/ixesha lokuhamba; amaxesha okuvula nokuvala; amaxesha abhukishiweyo; izithuthi ezilindelekileyo; ixesha elifunekayo kwindawo nganye; ukufikeleleka okanye iimfuno zeqela. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: A visitor exchanges €300 when the exchange rate is R20.50 for €1. Ignore commission. Calculate how many rand the visitor receives.
questionText.af: ’n Besoeker ruil €300 om wanneer die wisselkoers R20,50 vir €1 is. Ignoreer kommissie. Bereken hoeveel rand die besoeker ontvang.
questionText.xh: Undwendwe utshintsha i-€300 xa izinga lotshintshiselwano lingu-R20.50 nge-€1. Ungayibali ikhomishini. Bala ukuba zingaphi iirandi azifumanayo.

scaffoldHint.en: Multiply the euro amount by the rand value of one euro.
scaffoldHint.af: Vermenigvuldig die euro-bedrag met die randwaarde van een euro.
scaffoldHint.xh: Phinda-phinda isixa see-euro ngexabiso lerandi le-euro enye.

questionText.en: Explain TWO reasons why a well-known natural or cultural attraction can stimulate tourism in the surrounding area, not only at the attraction itself.
questionText.af: Verduidelik TWEE redes waarom ’n bekende natuurlike of kulturele besienswaardigheid toerisme in die omliggende gebied kan stimuleer, en nie net by die besienswaardigheid self nie.
questionText.xh: Chaza IZIZATHU EZIMBINI zokuba kutheni indawo edumileyo yendalo okanye yenkcubeko inokukhuthaza ukhenketho kummandla oyijikelezileyo, hayi kwindawo leyo kuphela.

scaffoldHint.en: Think accommodation, restaurants, transport, guiding, shopping and longer visitor stays.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan verblyf, restaurante, vervoer, gidse, inkopies en langer verblyf van besoekers.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngeendawo zokuhlala, iindawo zokutyela, izithuthi, abakhokeli, ukuthenga kunye nokuhlala ixesha elide.

memoText.en: Any two explained: visitors spend on nearby accommodation, food, transport, guiding and retail; the attraction creates jobs and business opportunities; it can encourage longer stays and visits to nearby attractions. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Enige twee verduidelik: besoekers bestee aan nabygeleë verblyf, kos, vervoer, gidse en kleinhandel; die besienswaardigheid skep werk en sakegeleenthede; dit kan langer verblyf en besoeke aan nabygeleë besienswaardighede aanmoedig. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Naziphi na ezimbini ezichaziweyo: iindwendwe zichitha imali kwiindawo zokuhlala, ukutya, izithuthi, abakhokeli nakwiivenkile ezikufutshane; indawo idala imisebenzi namathuba oshishino; inokukhuthaza ukuhlala ixesha elide nokutyelela ezinye iindawo ezikufutshane. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: A heritage site asks visitors not to touch fragile objects and to stay on marked paths. Explain TWO reasons why these rules support sustainable heritage tourism.
questionText.af: ’n Erfenisterrein vra besoekers om nie brose voorwerpe aan te raak nie en op gemerkte roetes te bly. Verduidelik TWEE redes waarom hierdie reëls volhoubare erfenistoerisme ondersteun.
questionText.xh: Indawo yelifa icela iindwendwe ukuba zingazichukumisi izinto ezibuthathaka kwaye zihlale kwiindlela eziphawuliweyo. Chaza IZIZATHU EZIMBINI zokuba kutheni le mithetho ixhasa ukhenketho lwelifa oluzinzileyo.

scaffoldHint.en: Link visitor behaviour to conservation and future access.
scaffoldHint.af: Koppel besoekersgedrag aan bewaring en toekomstige toegang.
scaffoldHint.xh: Dibanisa indlela yokuziphatha kweendwendwe nokugcinwa kwelifa kunye nokufikelela kwixa elizayo.

memoText.en: The rules reduce physical damage and deterioration of heritage resources; they help conserve the site so future visitors and communities can continue to learn from and benefit from it. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Die reëls verminder fisiese skade en agteruitgang van erfenishulpbronne; dit help om die terrein te bewaar sodat toekomstige besoekers en gemeenskappe steeds daaruit kan leer en voordeel trek. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Imithetho inciphisa umonakalo nokonakala kwezixhobo zelifa; inceda ukugcina indawo ukuze iindwendwe noluntu lwexesha elizayo ziqhubeke nokufunda nokuxhamla kuyo. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: A Cape Winelands tourism business wants to attract young domestic weekend travellers. Identify TWO features its marketing message should emphasise and explain why each suits this target market.
questionText.af: ’n Toerismebesigheid in die Kaapse Wynlande wil jong plaaslike naweekreisigers lok. Identifiseer TWEE eienskappe wat sy bemarkingsboodskap moet beklemtoon en verduidelik waarom elkeen by hierdie teikenmark pas.
questionText.xh: Ishishini lezokhenketho eCape Winelands lifuna ukutsala abahambi basekhaya abaselula ngeempelaveki. Chonga IIMPAWU EZIMBINI ekufuneka umyalezo walo wentengiso uzigxininise uze uchaze ukuba kutheni nganye ilungele le marike ijoliswe kuyo.

scaffoldHint.en: Consider affordability, short travel time, experiences, social sharing, transport and weekend packages.
scaffoldHint.af: Oorweeg bekostigbaarheid, kort reistyd, ervarings, sosiale deel, vervoer en naweekpakkette.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngokufikeleleka kwamaxabiso, ixesha elifutshane lokuhamba, amava, ukwabelana kwimidiya yoluntu, izithuthi kunye neepakethi zeempelaveki.

memoText.en: Any two suitable features with explanation: affordable packages; easy/short access; distinctive experiences; weekend convenience; transport options; shareable experiences or digital booking. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Enige twee geskikte eienskappe met verduideliking: bekostigbare pakkette; maklike/kort toegang; unieke ervarings; naweekgerief; vervoeropsies; deelbare ervarings of digitale bespreking. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Naziphi na ezimbini ezifanelekileyo ezichaziweyo: iipakethi ezifikelelekayo; ukufikelela lula/ngexesha elifutshane; amava awodwa; ukulungeleka kweempelaveki; iindlela zezithuthi; amava anokwabelwana ngawo okanye ukubhukisha ngedijithali. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: Explain how a flight cancellation can affect TWO other tourism sectors besides air transport.
questionText.af: Verduidelik hoe ’n vlugkansellasie TWEE ander toerismesektore buiten lugvervoer kan beïnvloed.
questionText.xh: Chaza ukuba ukurhoxiswa kwenqwelomoya kunokuchaphazela njani AMACANDELO AMABINI okhenketho ngaphandle kwezothutho lomoya.

scaffoldHint.en: Think accommodation, attractions, tour operators, car hire and restaurants.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan verblyf, besienswaardighede, toeroperateurs, motorhuur en restaurante.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngeendawo zokuhlala, iindawo zokundwendwela, abaququzeleli botyelelo, ukuqeshwa kweemoto kunye neendawo zokutyela.

memoText.en: Any two explained: hotels may lose or shift bookings; tour operators/attractions may miss scheduled visitors; car-hire bookings may change; restaurants and other services may lose expected spending. This demonstrates interdependence between tourism sectors. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Enige twee verduidelik: hotelle kan besprekings verloor of verskuif; toeroperateurs/besienswaardighede kan geskeduleerde besoekers mis; motorhuurbesprekings kan verander; restaurante en ander dienste kan verwagte besteding verloor. Dit toon die onderlinge afhanklikheid van toerismesektore. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Naziphi na ezimbini ezichaziweyo: iihotele zinokuphulukana okanye zitshintshe ukubhukisha; abaququzeleli botyelelo/iindawo zokundwendwela banokuphulukana neendwendwe ebezilindelekile; ukubhukishwa kweemoto kunokutshintsha; iindawo zokutyela nezinye iinkonzo zinokuphulukana nenkcitho ebilindelekile. Oku kubonisa ukuxhomekeka kwamacandelo okhenketho omnye komnye. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: A small guesthouse wants to become more responsible. Give ONE practical action for each of the environmental, social and economic pillars of sustainable tourism.
questionText.af: ’n Klein gastehuis wil meer verantwoordelik word. Gee EEN praktiese aksie vir elk van die omgewings-, sosiale en ekonomiese pilare van volhoubare toerisme.
questionText.xh: Indlu encinci yeendwendwe ifuna ukusebenza ngendlela enoxanduva ngakumbi. Nika ISENZO ESINYE esisebenzayo kwipali nganye: okusingqongileyo, ezentlalo nezoqoqosho zokhenketho oluzinzileyo.

scaffoldHint.en: Environmental: resources/waste. Social: people/community. Economic: local jobs/suppliers and long-term viability.
scaffoldHint.af: Omgewing: hulpbronne/afval. Sosiaal: mense/gemeenskap. Ekonomies: plaaslike werk/verskaffers en langtermyn-lewensvatbaarheid.
scaffoldHint.xh: Okusingqongileyo: izixhobo/inkunkuma. Ezentlalo: abantu/uluntu. Ezoqoqosho: imisebenzi/ababoneleli bendawo kunye nokusebenza ixesha elide.

memoText.en: Examples: environmental—save water/energy or reduce waste (2); social—respect local culture, improve accessibility or support community initiatives (2); economic—employ locally, buy from local suppliers or keep the business financially sustainable (2).
memoText.af: Voorbeelde: omgewing—bespaar water/energie of verminder afval (2); sosiaal—respekteer plaaslike kultuur, verbeter toeganklikheid of ondersteun gemeenskapsinisiatiewe (2); ekonomies—stel plaaslik aan, koop by plaaslike verskaffers of hou die besigheid finansieel volhoubaar (2).
memoText.xh: Imizekelo: okusingqongileyo—onga amanzi/amandla okanye unciphise inkunkuma (2); ezentlalo—hlonipha inkcubeko yendawo, phucula ukufikeleleka okanye uxhase amanyathelo oluntu (2); ezoqoqosho—qesha abantu bendawo, thenga kubaboneleli bendawo okanye ugcine ishishini lizinzile ngokwezimali (2).

questionText.en: Explain TWO ways in which stronger domestic tourism can help a destination when international visitor numbers fall.
questionText.af: Verduidelik TWEE maniere waarop sterker plaaslike toerisme ’n bestemming kan help wanneer internasionale besoekergetalle daal.
questionText.xh: Chaza IINDLELA EZIMBINI apho ukhenketho lwasekhaya olomeleleyo lunokunceda indawo xa amanani eendwendwe zamazwe ngamazwe ehla.

scaffoldHint.en: Think demand, jobs, local spending and reducing dependence on one market.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan vraag, werk, plaaslike besteding en die vermindering van afhanklikheid van een mark.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngemfuno, imisebenzi, inkcitho yasekhaya kunye nokunciphisa ukuxhomekeka kwimarike enye.

memoText.en: Domestic visitors can maintain demand and spending for accommodation, attractions and services; this supports jobs/businesses and reduces dependence on international markets. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Plaaslike besoekers kan vraag en besteding aan verblyf, besienswaardighede en dienste handhaaf; dit ondersteun werk/besighede en verminder afhanklikheid van internasionale markte. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Iindwendwe zasekhaya zinokugcina imfuno nenkcitho kwiindawo zokuhlala, iindawo zokundwendwela nakwiinkonzo; oku kuxhasa imisebenzi/amashishini kwaye kunciphisa ukuxhomekeka kwiimarike zamazwe ngamazwe. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: A destination experiences a sudden transport disruption during peak season. Explain TWO likely effects on its tourism industry.
questionText.af: ’n Bestemming ervaar ’n skielike vervoerverstoring gedurende die hoogseisoen. Verduidelik TWEE waarskynlike gevolge vir sy toerismebedryf.
questionText.xh: Indawo ifumana ukuphazamiseka ngesiquphe kwezothutho ngexesha lexesha elixakekileyo. Chaza IZIPHUMO EZIMBINI ezinokwenzeka kushishino lwayo lwezokhenketho.

scaffoldHint.en: Consider cancellations, visitor confidence, occupancy, spending and future bookings.
scaffoldHint.af: Oorweeg kansellasies, besoekersvertroue, besetting, besteding en toekomstige besprekings.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngokurhoxiswa, ukuzithemba kweendwendwe, ukuzaliswa kweendawo, inkcitho kunye nokubhukisha kwixesha elizayo.

memoText.en: Any two explained: cancellations or delayed arrivals; lower occupancy and visitor spending; disruption to tours and attractions; reduced visitor confidence; possible damage to future bookings if disruption is prolonged. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Enige twee verduidelik: kansellasies of vertraagde aankomste; laer besetting en besoekersbesteding; ontwrigting van toere en besienswaardighede; laer besoekersvertroue; moontlike skade aan toekomstige besprekings as die ontwrigting voortduur. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Naziphi na ezimbini ezichaziweyo: ukurhoxiswa okanye ukufika emva kwexesha; ukwehla kokuzaliswa kweendawo nenkcitho yeendwendwe; ukuphazamiseka kotyelelo neendawo zokundwendwela; ukwehla kokuzithemba kweendwendwe; ukonakala kokubhukisha kwixesha elizayo xa ukuphazamiseka kuqhubeka. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: A guest complains that a booked room is not ready on arrival. State TWO appropriate actions the staff member should take and explain how each action supports good customer care.
questionText.af: ’n Gas kla dat ’n bespreekte kamer nie gereed is met aankoms nie. Noem TWEE gepaste optredes wat die personeellid moet neem en verduidelik hoe elkeen goeie kliëntediens ondersteun.
questionText.xh: Undwendwe lukhalaza kuba igumbi elibhukishiweyo alikakulungeli xa lufika. Chaza AMANYATHELO AMABINI afanelekileyo ekufuneka umqeshwa awathathe uze uchaze ukuba ngalinye lixhasa njani inkathalo entle yabathengi.

scaffoldHint.en: Think listening, apology, explanation, solution and follow-up.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan luister, verskoning, verduideliking, oplossing en opvolg.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngokumamela, ukucela uxolo, ukuchaza, ukusombulula ingxaki kunye nokulandela.

memoText.en: Any two with explanation: listen and acknowledge the complaint; apologise professionally; explain the situation honestly; offer a realistic solution/alternative; follow up to confirm satisfaction. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Enige twee met verduideliking: luister en erken die klagte; vra professioneel om verskoning; verduidelik die situasie eerlik; bied ’n realistiese oplossing/alternatief; volg op om tevredenheid te bevestig. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Naziphi na ezimbini ezichaziweyo: mamela uze wamkele isikhalazo; cela uxolo ngobungcali; chaza imeko ngokunyanisekileyo; nikezela ngesisombululo/enye indlela enokwenzeka; landela ukuqinisekisa ukwaneliseka. (2 x 2)

questionText.en: Explain TWO reasons why consistent service standards are important for a tourism business that depends on repeat visitors and online reviews.
questionText.af: Verduidelik TWEE redes waarom konsekwente diensstandaarde belangrik is vir ’n toerismebesigheid wat van herhaalbesoekers en aanlyn resensies afhanklik is.
questionText.xh: Chaza IZIZATHU EZIMBINI zokuba kutheni imigangatho yenkonzo engaguquguqukiyo ibalulekile kwishishini lezokhenketho elixhomekeke kwiindwendwe ezibuyayo nakuphononongo lwe-intanethi.

scaffoldHint.en: Link consistency to trust, reputation, satisfaction, recommendations and repeat business.
scaffoldHint.af: Koppel konsekwentheid aan vertroue, reputasie, tevredenheid, aanbevelings en herhaalbesigheid.
scaffoldHint.xh: Dibanisa ukungaguquguquki nentembeko, udumo, ukwaneliseka, iingcebiso kunye nokubuya kwabathengi.

memoText.en: Consistent service builds trust and customer satisfaction, increasing repeat business; it also protects the business reputation and encourages positive reviews and recommendations. (2 x 2)
memoText.af: Konsekwente diens bou vertroue en kliëntetevredenheid, wat herhaalbesigheid verhoog; dit beskerm ook die besigheid se reputasie en bevorder positiewe resensies en aanbevelings. (2 x 2)
memoText.xh: Inkonzo engaguquguqukiyo yakha intembeko nokwaneliseka kwabathengi, nto leyo eyandisa ukubuyela kwabo; ikwakhusela udumo lweshishini kwaye ikhuthaza uphononongo neengcebiso ezilungileyo. (2 x 2)
